threshold_note: Conservative starter value. Calibrate it against human-confirmed records before enabling autonomous decisions in another dataset.

criteria.cache: Cache strategies: invalidation, TTL, semantic cache, CDN, write-through and cache stampede.
criteria.kafka: Apache Kafka: topics, partitions, consumer groups and event streaming.
criteria.redis: Redis as an in-memory data store: data structures, persistence, pub/sub, cache and queues.
criteria.kubernetes: Kubernetes orchestration: pods, deployments, YAML, Helm, operators and clusters.
criteria.system_design: System design and distributed architecture: scalability, trade-offs, patterns, databases and interviews.
criteria.ci_cd: Continuous integration and delivery: pipelines, GitHub Actions, deployments, staging and rollback.
criteria.RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: embeddings, vector databases, chunking, reranking and hybrid search.
criteria.ai_security: AI security and risks: deepfakes, voice cloning, prompt injection, watermarking and jailbreaks.
criteria.ai_portfolio: Projects, ideas and resources for building an AI and technology career or portfolio.
criteria.uncategorized: The content does not clearly fit another category or there is not enough evidence to decide.
